decided: When orbit cannot produce a change's brief at its archive, the archive still completes, notes the failure in its own record, and shows nothing about it at the default settings.
alternatives: show a one-line notice whenever it fails, which would need its own named exception to G0
stop the archive until the brief can be produced
why: At the default settings nothing waits on the brief, so a notice would change what a default archive shows for a copy no one is reading; when a sign-off is on, it cannot go ahead without a saved copy, so the failure reaches the user there. Stopping the archive would let a missing brief block work, which a default install never did.
